title: Friday Happy Hour with Duo Laroo/Byrd
description: Friday after-work drinks with live music. Saskia Laroo (trumpet, saxophone, bass, vocals) and Warren Byrd (keys, vocals, bongos) play live jazz, funk, soul and spontaneous improvisation, during the group exhibition Alone Together. Enjoy the art, have a drink and unwind after the work week. Presented by Paulien Lethen. Suggested donation $10.
